run_azure_client_usage_test: run the azure client usage test to check for direct AzureOpenAI instantiations in litellm azure modules
find_azure_files: find all python files recursively in a given base directory
check_direct_instantiation: check a python file for direct AzureOpenAI or AsyncAzureOpenAI instantiation using AST parsing
review_azure_client_usage: review azure llm modules to ensure they use get_azure_openai_client instead of direct instantiation
test_azure_client_patterns: test that azure modules avoid direct AzureOpenAI instantiation outside BaseAzureLLM class methods
